AA0001.justification: Spacing around binary operators is pure layout the formatter fixes; no behaviour changes, so a gate from Strict only.

AA0002.justification: A stray space after a unary operator is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0003.justification: Spacing after NOT is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0005.justification: BEGIN..END around a single statement is clutter, not a defect; style gated from Strict.

AA0008.justification: Parentheses on parameterless calls tell a call from a field or variable at a glance; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0013.justification: Placement of BEGIN after THEN, ELSE or DO is pure layout the formatter fixes; a gate from Strict only.

AA0018.justification: Control keywords that do not start a line are layout only and the formatter fixes them; a gate from Strict only.

AA0021.justification: Ordering declarations by type is a house style with no effect on behaviour and many hits in old code; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0022.justification: Rewriting IF ELSE chains as CASE is a readability opinion; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0040.justification: Nested WITH makes it unclear which record a name binds to and can bind the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0050.justification: Granting permissions on another app's objects from a permission set extension breaks when that app changes and widens access silently; Warning from Recommended.

AA0051.justification: Pulling another app's permission sets into an extension couples to permissions you do not own and widens access; Warning from Recommended.

AA0052.justification: Including sets that carry permissions on another app's objects widens access through a set you do not control; Warning from Recommended.

AA0053.justification: A wildcard in a permission set extension grants every object to everyone holding the base set; Warning from Essential as a security rule.

AA0072.justification: Opt-in naming rule that suffixes names with their type; an opinion many codebases reject, Info in Complete only.

AA0073.justification: A temporary record without the Temp prefix invites DeleteAll or Modify on what a reader thinks is real data; Warning from Recommended.

AA0074.justification: Approved label suffixes (Msg, Err, Qst, Tok, Lbl) show how a text is used; naming advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0087.justification: The lower-permissions test library declared outside a test codeunit drags test tooling into production code; Warning from Recommended.

AA0100.justification: Quoted identifiers make code harder to read and search; naming advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0101.justification: API page property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.

AA0102.justification: API page field names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.

AA0103.justification: API query property values are a public contract that cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.

AA0104.justification: API query column names are the JSON contract and cannot be renamed after release; camelCase must be right before shipping, Warning from Recommended.

AA0105.justification: A page part that embeds its own parent page recurses and fails when the page opens; Error everywhere.

AA0106.justification: An API page that uses the same subpage twice fails when the API is called; Error everywhere.

AA0131.justification: Arguments that do not match the placeholders leave raw %1 text or drop values in user messages; Warning from Recommended.

AA0136.justification: Unreachable code usually means a misplaced exit or condition, a likely bug; Warning from Recommended.

AA0137.justification: An unused variable is dead weight that hides typos; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0139.justification: Assigning longer text to a shorter target overflows at runtime once the value is long enough; Warning from Recommended.

AA0150.justification: A var parameter that is never written misleads callers about side effects; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0161.justification: AssertError belongs to the test runner; outside a test codeunit it signals test logic in production code; Warning from Recommended.

AA0175.justification: Finding a record whose values are never used costs a database round trip for nothing; performance, Warning from Recommended.

AA0181.justification: FindSet or Find without Next fetches a result set that is never iterated; performance, Warning from Recommended.

AA0189.justification: An invalid ApplicationArea value hides the control from users; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0194.justification: An action with no trigger and no run object shows a button that does nothing; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0198.justification: A local that shadows a global makes it easy to read or write the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0199.justification: The order of ApplicationArea values has no effect; consistency only, Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0200.justification: Values listed next to All are redundant and suggest a misunderstanding of the setting; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0201.justification: Basic without Suite can hide the control in experiences that enable Suite only; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0202.justification: A local named like a field, method or action shadows it and code silently uses the local; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0203.justification: A method named like a field or action makes calls and field access ambiguous to readers; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0204.justification: A global named like a field, method or action shadows it across the object; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0205.justification: Reading a variable before any assignment relies on a default value and often hides a missing initialisation; Warning from Recommended.

AA0206.justification: A value assigned and never read is a dead store that can hide a lost result; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0207.justification: A non-local event subscriber becomes callable API surface that cannot be changed later; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.

AA0210.justification: Filtering on fields without a supporting key scans tables; a performance hint with false positives, advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0211.justification: CalcFields on a field that is neither a FlowField nor a Blob throws a runtime error when it runs; Error everywhere.

AA0213.justification: An obsolete marking without state or reason either does not obsolete at all or leaves consumers no guidance; Warning from Recommended.

AA0214.justification: Modify on a record that was not changed costs a write for nothing or reveals a missing assignment; Warning from Recommended.

AA0215.justification: File naming conventions help navigation but renaming old files is churn; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

AA0216.justification: Concatenated user messages cannot be translated as a whole; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0217.justification: A literal format string in StrSubstNo cannot be translated; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0218.justification: Page fields and actions without a tooltip leave users without in-product help; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0219.justification: Opt-in wording rule for tooltips starting with Specifies; style, Info in Complete only.

AA0220.justification: An empty tooltip shows users a blank help bubble; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0221.justification: Option controls without OptionCaption show untranslated raw option names; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0222.justification: SIFT on a primary or unique key maintains totals over single rows, a write cost with no benefit; performance, Warning from Recommended.

AA0223.justification: An empty OptionCaption shows users blank option values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0224.justification: A caption count that differs from the options shows users wrong or missing values; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0225.justification: Page fields without a caption fall back to the source name and may not translate; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0226.justification: An empty caption shows users a field without a label; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AA0227.justification: An unchecked Get or Find in an upgrade codeunit throws when data is missing and aborts the tenant upgrade; Warning from Essential as a deployment risk.

AA0228.justification: An unused local method is dead code to maintain; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0230.justification: Pinning a version on a platform assembly breaks the reference when the platform updates; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.

AA0231.justification: StrSubstNo or concatenation inside Error hides the label from telemetry and translation; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0232.justification: A FlowField without a supporting SIFT key computes by scanning; a performance hint, advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0233.justification: Next after Get, FindFirst or FindLast loops on a single-row fetch and reads row by row; performance and likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AA0234.justification: Opt-in rule for tooltips on table fields; useful but noisy in older code, Info in Complete only.

AA0235.justification: Per-company install code without a company-initialise subscriber leaves companies created later unconfigured; a real defect, raised to Warning from Recommended.

AA0237.justification: A real record named Temp invites DeleteAll on what a reader thinks is a buffer, risking data loss; Warning from Recommended.

AA0240.justification: E-mail addresses and phone numbers in source leak personal data into the repository and the app; Warning from Recommended given test-data false positives.

AA0241.justification: Lowercase keywords are style; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.

AA0242.justification: Reading a field not in SetLoadFields triggers an extra JIT load per record; performance, Warning from Recommended.

AA0243.justification: Running a codeunit of subtype Upgrade throws a runtime error; Error everywhere.

AA0244.justification: A parameter named like a global shadows it so the body may use the wrong one; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0245.justification: A parameter named like a field, method or action shadows it within the method; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AA0246.justification: A pragma that disables every diagnostic hides real errors and future warnings; Warning from Recommended.

AA0247.justification: Namespaces avoid name clashes and are the platform direction; advisory while code migrates, a gate from Strict.

AA0248.justification: The this qualifier is a readability preference; Hidden keeps the code action available, visible from Strict.

AA0249.justification: A page field trigger that a property disables never runs, so its logic is silently skipped; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AA0250.justification: An obsoleted external business event without the marker keeps Power Automate users unaware of its removal; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.

AA0251.justification: An event marked obsolete in its name but not by attribute is inconsistent metadata, not a runtime failure; Warning from Recommended, kept below the Error default.

AA0252.justification: Moving a table that carries external business events moves the events and breaks subscribed external flows; an upgrade break, not a runtime failure, Warning from Recommended.

AA0448.justification: FieldName and TableName show untranslated names where FieldCaption and TableCaption translate; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0462.justification: A CalcDate formula string without angle brackets is parsed in the user's language and gives wrong dates elsewhere; Warning from Recommended.

AA0470.justification: Placeholders without a comment leave translators guessing what is substituted; localizability advice, a gate from Strict.

AA0471.justification: Opt-in rule for AutoFormatType on decimal page fields; formatting advice, Info in Complete only.

AA0472.justification: Opt-in rule for AutoFormatExpression on amount page fields; formatting advice, Info in Complete only.

AA0473.justification: Opt-in rule for AutoFormatType on decimal table fields; formatting advice, Info in Complete only.

AA0474.justification: Opt-in rule for AutoFormatExpression on amount table fields; formatting advice, Info in Complete only.

AA0475.justification: Truncate outside its supported cases throws at runtime; Error everywhere.

AA0476.justification: An AI test suite file that fails schema validation cannot be loaded by the test tool; a definite test failure, Error from Recommended as only tests are hit.

AA0477.justification: Unordered using directives are cosmetic and the code action sorts them; Info at Strict, gated in Complete.

PC0000.justification: Only signal that a PlatformCop analyzer crashed and its checks did not run; always visible, never blocking.

PC0001.justification: An editable FlowField takes user input and the platform silently discards it; a user-facing defect, Warning from Essential.

PC0002.justification: AutoIncrement on a temporary table has no SQL to generate the value, so the insert fails at runtime; Error everywhere.

PC0003.justification: SetRange takes filter operators literally, so the filter matches the wrong records or none; a definite wrong result, Error everywhere.

PC0004.justification: Index 0 on a one-based List raises an index-out-of-range error at runtime; Error everywhere.

PC0005.justification: Leaving Extensible implicit lets dependants extend objects you meant to keep closed; opt-in design advice, Complete only.

PC0006.justification: Leaving Access implicit locks helper objects into the public surface; opt-in design advice, Complete only.

PC0007.justification: Passing a field that is neither FlowField nor Blob to SetAutoCalcFields raises a runtime error; Error everywhere.

PC0008.justification: With wildcard or case operators SetFilter leaves the placeholder unsubstituted and returns the wrong records; Error everywhere.

PC0010.justification: A subscriber without var gets a copy, so its changes never reach the publisher; often harmless for a read only subscriber, Warning from Recommended.

PC0011.justification: A handled flag passed by value can never be raised by subscribers, so the IsHandled pattern is broken for every extender; Warning from Essential.

PC0012.justification: Assigning a FlowFilter field sets no filter, so CalcFields sums every record; a silent wrong result, Warning from Essential.

PC0013.justification: Get arguments that do not match the primary key fetch the wrong record or fail with a type error at runtime; Error everywhere.

PC0014.justification: Double quotes in a JPath make SelectToken silently return nothing; a definite wrong result, Warning from Essential.

PC0015.justification: Comparing a Guid with an empty string fails to parse and throws at runtime; Error everywhere.

PC0016.justification: Clear or ClearAll leaves a SingleInstance codeunit's state intact, so an intended reset silently does nothing; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

PC0017.justification: A record that does not match the page's source table fails with a conversion error when the page or lookup runs; Error everywhere.

PC0018.justification: Record methods on a page without a source table have no buffer, so the page opens without the passed record; Error everywhere.

PC0019.justification: The not-empty filter escaped with three quotes filters on a single quote instead of empty; a silent wrong result, Warning from Essential.

PC0020.justification: TransferFields between fields of one id with incompatible types throws at runtime, also in base app posting; Error everywhere.

PC0021.justification: Same field id under different names across a TransferFields pair copies values into the wrong field; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

PC0022.justification: Text that may exceed the target length through Validate, SetFilter, Get or a translated label throws at runtime; Warning from Recommended like AA0139.

PC0023.justification: A subscriber that can lower the handled flag undoes an earlier subscriber's decision; an extensibility bug, Warning from Recommended.

PC0024.justification: ApplicationArea on an API page is ignored and only adds noise; cleanup advice, a gate from Strict.

PC0025.justification: A business key in ODataKeyFields breaks Power Automate and stored links, and changing it after release breaks consumers; Warning from Essential.

PC0026.justification: An API page without id and lastModifiedDateTime lacks a stable identifier and silently loses webhooks; Warning from Recommended.

PC0027.justification: Running table triggers on a temporary record can write to the database through trigger code; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

PC0028.justification: A field shorter than the field it relates to truncates looked up values and fails validation; a likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

PC0029.justification: Random GUIDs in key fields fragment the SQL index and slow inserts; performance advice, a gate from Strict.

PC0030.justification: Reads without SetLoadFields fetch every column; performance advice that fires on most reads, a gate from Strict.

PC0031.justification: Partial records before a full-record write force a JIT load that costs a roundtrip and can fail under concurrency; Warning from Recommended.

PC0032.justification: A layout Caption or Summary over 250 characters makes the Report Layout Selection page fail at runtime; Error everywhere.

PC0033.justification: Control names that collide after the OData name mapping make Edit in Excel and OData calls fail; Warning from Essential.

PC0034.justification: A placeholder without a matching argument shows a literal placeholder to the user; a user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended like AA0131.

PC0035.justification: CalcFields inside a loop issues one query per row and FlowField; a performance defect, Warning from Recommended.

PC0036.justification: SetRecord does not accept a temporary record and raises a runtime error; Error everywhere.

PC0037.justification: Direct field assignment skips OnValidate and its subscribers, but fires on most assignments and is often deliberate; advice from Strict, a gate in Complete.

PC0038.justification: A path that falls through returns an implicit default and can hide a logic bug; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0000.justification: Reports that an analyzer crashed, not a defect in the code; always visible, never blocking.

AC0001.justification: A list page source table without lookup and drill-down pages leaves users no way to open the record from a field value; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0002.justification: A blank single-field key lets a later delete or rename cascade into every unrelated record with an empty relation field; data-loss risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0003.justification: NotBlank on a key filled by a number series rejects every new record in the client before OnInsert runs; Warning from Essential since detection is heuristic.

AC0004.justification: A direct Confirm call fails at runtime in job queues and web service calls where no UI exists; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AC0005.justification: Switching the session language by hand risks leaving it switched when the restore is missed or an error interrupts; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0006.justification: Hardcoding the page for document and setup tables opens the wrong variant, for example a quote on the order page; Warning from Recommended.

AC0007.justification: A public install or upgrade codeunit invites other apps to call it, so later cleanup becomes a breaking change; upgrade risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0008.justification: Opt-in check that records the per-company storage choice explicitly, since changing it later needs empty tables; Info in Complete only.

AC0009.justification: A permission set caption without a length cap lets translations exceed 30 characters and get truncated in the list; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0010.justification: Objects outside every permission set force administrators to grant access by hand before users can work; Warning from Recommended.

AC0011.justification: Without a caption a user-facing element gets no translation unit and shows the AL identifier in every language; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0012.justification: An integration event in an internal codeunit cannot be subscribed to from other apps, so the extension point is dead; Warning from Recommended.

AC0013.justification: Opt-in check for DropDown and Brick field groups so lookups and tiles show useful fields; Info in Complete only.

AC0014.justification: Tooltip text without closing punctuation is a style lapse against the user assistance guidelines; too cosmetic to advise, a gate from Strict.

AC0015.justification: Field tooltips that do not open with Specifies break the wording convention of the standard application; style, a gate from Strict.

AC0016.justification: A line break escape in a tooltip renders as a literal backslash in the client; visible defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0017.justification: Tooltips over 200 characters turn a quick hint into a block of text users must read; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0018.justification: An unlocked empty caption adds a blank translation unit that translators must skip in every language; translation hygiene, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0019.justification: A meaningful value at ordinal zero cannot be told apart from the default every new record gets; design advice, a gate from Strict.

AC0020.justification: A token label left translatable can be translated and break the API key or identifier it carries; likely bug, Warning from Recommended.

AC0021.justification: Opt-in naming check that marks every locked label as a token; Info in Complete only.

AC0022.justification: A caption on the empty enum value is dead metadata the platform ignores; harmless clutter, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0023.justification: An enum value with an empty caption cannot be picked in dropdowns; user-facing defect, Warning from Recommended.

AC0024.justification: A public event publisher freezes its signature as public API while subscribers need no public access; extensibility risk, Warning from Recommended.

AC0025.justification: Assigning the magic number 10 for a line feed hides intent that the Type Helper separators state; readability, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0026.justification: A field kept off every page can still be added and edited through page customization unless its exposure is set; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0027.justification: A locked label whose text equals its name is a token and should say so with its suffix; naming refinement, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0028.justification: A tooltip kept on the page instead of the table field must be copied to every page and goes stale; maintainability, a gate from Strict.

AC0029.justification: A page tooltip that repeats the table field tooltip stops following later table edits; maintainability, advisory then a gate from Strict.

AC0030.justification: A discarded Get or Find result raises only the generic platform error, often deliberately; noisy advice, Info from Strict.

AC0031.justification: Table access without declared object permissions fails for users who hold only indirect permissions; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0032.justification: Declared permissions the code never uses mislead anyone auditing what the object touches; advisory, a gate from Strict.

AC0033.justification: Advice that the app ships its own Rest Client handler so its own HTTP setting governs its calls; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.

AC0034.justification: Advice that the app carries its own Telemetry Logger instead of relying on another app of the publisher; ALCops makes it opt-in upstream, Info in Complete only.

LC0000.justification: Only signal that a LinterCop analyzer crashed and checked nothing; always visible, never blocking.

LC0003.justification: A numeric object id compiles silently when the object is renumbered or renamed, hiding drift a name would catch; Warning from Recommended.

LC0007.justification: Reports a maintainability score, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0008.justification: A low maintainability score marks code that is costly to change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0009.justification: Reports a cyclomatic complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0010.justification: Too many execution paths make a procedure hard to test and change safely; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0019.justification: A field repeating the table data classification keeps the old value when the table changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0020.justification: A control repeating the page application area keeps the old value when the page changes; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0028.justification: String literals in subscriber arguments break go to definition and references; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0031.justification: LockTable widens locks to every read of the table and disables optimistic reads; advisory because the fix is not mechanical, a gate from Strict.

LC0033.justification: A runtime behind the target only withholds newer language features and is often kept low on purpose for older servers; Info from Recommended.

LC0040.justification: A bare Insert, Modify or Delete hides whether skipping triggers was intended; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0043.justification: Credential held in Text is readable in the debugger and snapshot sessions; Warning from Essential as a security rule.

LC0048.justification: Error with plain Text replaces the message in telemetry with a placeholder, so failures cannot be diagnosed; Warning from Recommended.

LC0052.justification: An internal procedure nobody calls is dead code or a missing call; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0053.justification: An internal procedure used only in its own object exposes more scope than it needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0054.justification: The interface prefix contradicts the mandatory AppSource affixes and is opinion elsewhere; None everywhere.

LC0063.justification: Non-canonical API field names force consumers to map fields, but renaming a published field breaks integrations; Info until Complete.

LC0081.justification: Comparing Count with zero scans every matching row where IsEmpty reads one; a performance fix from Recommended.

LC0082.justification: Count equal to one scans every matching row where Find and Next read two; advisory since the rewrite needs judgment, a gate from Strict.

LC0083.justification: Numeric-argument date functions and Format round-trips obscure which part is read; readability advice, a gate from Strict.

LC0086.justification: A misspelled style string compiles and silently drops the styling the user should see; Warning from Recommended.

LC0088.justification: Option values cannot be extended by other apps and invite magic numbers; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0089.justification: Reports a cognitive complexity number, not a defect; Info in Complete only.

LC0089i.justification: One message per complexity increment is noise next to the metric and the threshold rule; None everywhere.

LC0090.justification: Deep nesting makes a procedure hard to read and easy to break three levels down; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0091.justification: A missing or unfinished translation shows source-language text to users in that locale; Warning from Recommended, silent without XLIFF files.

LC0092.justification: Inconsistent identifier naming makes symbol search unreliable and slows review; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0094.justification: A field repeating the object AllowInCustomizations value is redundant noise; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0095.justification: An unused parameter clutters the signature, but removing one from a public procedure breaks dependent apps; Info until Complete.

LC0096.justification: Passing a record to a method already called on it misleads readers about what the method needs; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0097.justification: Mixing exit and named return assignments is a style choice of an opt-in rule; Info in Complete only.

LC0098.justification: A subscriber name that does not encode source and event hides what it reacts to; advisory, a gate from Strict.

LC0099.justification: An unused subscriber parameter clutters the signature and is safe to drop; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0000.justification: The only sign that the documentation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

DC0001.justification: A manual commit without a reason invites a later refactor to remove or copy it blindly; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0002.justification: A write to a calculated field is not stored and looks like a bug unless a comment says why; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0003.justification: A stray semicolon is either leftover code or an undocumented no-op; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0004.justification: Public procedures without XML docs leave callers guessing in IntelliSense; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0005.justification: XML docs that name missing parameters mislead callers in signature help; advisory, a gate from Strict.

DC0006.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal procedures; Info in Complete only.

DC0007.justification: Public objects without XML docs leave consumers without a stated purpose; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0008.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal objects; Info in Complete only.

DC0009.justification: Published events without XML docs leave subscribers guessing at when they fire; too noisy for most projects below Strict.

DC0010.justification: Opt-in documentation for internal events; Info in Complete only.

FC0000.justification: The only sign that the formatting analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

FC0001.justification: A semicolon after a procedure header is harmless style noise; advisory below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0002.justification: Casing that differs from the declaration is pure style with a code fix; floods legacy code, so a gate from Strict.

FC0003.justification: A call without parentheses reads like a property access; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0004.justification: Unsorted permission entries cause avoidable merge conflicts and a code fix sorts them; advisory, a gate from Strict.

FC0005.justification: Assignment syntax hides that a method runs; style below the author default, a gate from Strict.

FC0006.justification: Uppercase permission letters wrongly suggest a direct grant but change nothing at runtime; opinion, Warning in Complete.

FC0007.justification: Blank lines between statement blocks are an opt-in layout preference; Info in Complete only.

TA0000.justification: The only sign that the test automation analyzer crashed and skipped code; visible at every level, never blocking.

TA0001.justification: A global procedure in a test codeunit is either a missed test attribute or a misplaced helper; advisory, a gate from Strict.

TA0002.justification: Invoking an action on a part opened on its own fails the test at runtime; Error from Recommended as only test code is hit.

CM0001.justification: A broken or unreadable alcops.json silently falls back to defaults and disables intended rules; Warning at every level.
